svg.title: Pluggable persistence — the same call, two stores

g.text: Pluggable persistence — the same call, two stores
Composition time — happens once, at start-up
An unknown driver stops the process at
boot rather than failing on the first
Request time — the service is unaware of any of the above
assertions against both adapters with their
clients mocked, proving the swap is
The two stores are independent databases.
Orders written under one driver are
visible under the other — expected, not a bug.
